details: Preliminary data indicates Eurozone inflation likely rose to 3.0% in August, with core inflation also increasing. This strengthens expectations for the European Central Bank (ECB) to raise interest rates by 0.25 percentage points on September 10, partly driven by elevated energy prices linked to ongoing Middle East conflict. Economists anticipate inflation moving higher, making an ECB interest rate increase all but certain.
title: ECB Poised for September Rate Hike as Eurozone Inflation Rises

details: Russia's Sberbank plans to allow Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether to be used as loan collateral. This strategic move is contingent on new crypto regulations taking effect and the Bank of Russia permitting the public circulation of these assets. The bank has already conducted pilot transactions using crypto as loan security, signaling a significant step towards broader cryptocurrency integration into traditional finance.
title: Sberbank to Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether as Loan Collateral

details: Bitcoin's price dropped to $78,400 after Federal Reserve official Christopher Warsh downplayed the significance of recent softer inflation figures. His remarks suggest that the Fed may maintain a cautious monetary policy stance despite easing inflation, impacting investor sentiment in the crypto market. This highlights ongoing uncertainty about future Fed actions and their effect on risk assets like Bitcoin.
title: Fed Official Signals Continued Caution on Inflation, Bitcoin Dips

details: Wall Street enters September, which is historically the worst month for US stocks, with the S&P 500 typically experiencing losses. Bitcoin and Ethereum also historically post their weakest average monthly returns in September. This seasonal trend suggests potential volatility and caution for crypto investors as the new month begins, despite a strong August performance for both markets.
title: September Historically Weak for Stocks and Cryptocurrencies
